title_en: Yingzao Fashi: Twelfth-Century Chinese Building Manual
scope: Modern article about the Yingzao Fashi and Song Chinese building standards; the supplied PDF is not the historical manual itself.
relevance: Useful comparative explanation of an explicitly described timber grading system. It supplies no established construction rule or dimension for a Joseon building.

access.note: Acquired by copying the owner's supplied EastAsia_ArchitectureCorpus PDF. The stable JSTOR URL is printed on PDF page 1; use that article record for authorized reacquisition if needed. Online access was not tested in this batch. The retained PDF includes the JSTOR wrapper as page 1.

notes.statement: Guo describes the Yingzao Fashi's cai-fen system as a modular system with eight timber grades related to building scale, illustrated in figure 2. The discussion places this system within Song Chinese state building standards.
notes.scope: Guo's account of the historical Chinese manual. Its application to Joseon construction has not been established, and none of its units or dimensions has been adopted for this project's buildings.
